statements.t: We are a global, commercial-stage oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing novel targeted therapies for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.

We also have other preclinical-stage RAS(ON) Inhibitor clinical development opportunities, including the RAS(ON) mutant-selective inhibitors RMC-0708 (Q61H) and RMC-8839 (G13C) and additional novel targeted approaches for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
We are nearing selection of a candidate recommended Phase 2 dose for RMC-5127 and currently expect to share initial clinical monotherapy data in 2027.
We currently expect to initiate a first-in-human clinical trial evaluating RM-055, a representative from this class of RAS(ON) Inhibitors, in the fourth quarter of 2026.
We believe our inventory on hand and planned manufacturing position us to meet anticipated market demand.
Because of this unmet need and the prevalence of RAS as a driver of PDAC, we believe that pancreatic cancer represents a particularly compelling opportunity for RAS-targeted therapies.
We have completed U.S. enrollment in RASolute 303 and currently expect to complete global enrollment in the first half of 2027;
We currently expect to complete enrollment in RASolve 301 by the end of November 2026, to enable an expected clinical readout in 2027;
We plan to continue evaluating RASONQUE in NSCLC in combination with bispecific antibodies targeting both the PD-1/PD-L1 and VEGF axes.
We currently expect to provide a clinical data update and the trial design for RASonate 312 in the first half of 2027.

In August 2026, we entered into a multi-part collaboration with BeOne Medicines I GmbH (BeOne) which included a clinical collaboration pursuant to which BeOne plans to evaluate drug combinations incorporating RASONQUE, zoldonrasib, elironrasib and/or RMC-5127 with select clinical-stage oncology assets from BeOne, including the MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor BGB-58067 and the EGFR × MET × MET trispecific antibody…

Additionally, in October 2026, we entered into a multi-part clinical collaboration with BMS pursuant to which pumitamig (BNT327), a PD-L1/VEGF bispecific antibody jointly developed by BioNTech and BMS, will be evaluated in four planned study cohorts.
We will sponsor and lead two additional study cohorts under this collaboration: (i) zoldonrasib in combination with pumitamig in CRC; and (ii) elironrasib in combination with pumitamig in NSCLC.
Our aim in this collaboration is to enhance our lead discovery and optimization processes directed against both current and new drug targets to enable continued development of our pipeline.

(Aethon) pursuant to which Aethon is conducting research related to use of novel bispecific antibodies to mount an immune attack directed at the cancer cells targeted by our RAS(ON) Inhibitors (the Aethon Collaboration Agreement).
We expect product revenue to increase in future periods given the sales of RASONQUE for the three months ended September 30, 2026 reflected a partial quarter of sales following approval.
We expect to continue to sell RASONQUE inventory with a zero-cost basis through the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.
We expect our cost of sales to increase as a percentage of product revenue, net in future periods as we produce and sell inventory that reflects the full cost of manufacturing the product.

We expect our research and development expenses to increase for the foreseeable future as we continue to invest in discovering and developing product candidates and advancing product candidates into later stages of development, which may include conducting larger clinical trials.

As a result, we are unable to determine the duration and completion costs of our research and development projects or clinical trials or if and to what extent we will generate revenue from the commercialization and sale of any of our product candidates (other than RASONQUE), if approved.

We expect our selling, general and administrative expenses to increase for the foreseeable future due to anticipated increases in operating, selling and commercial activities in support of the commercialization of RASONQUE, which may result in increases in personnel-related costs associated with increased headcount, other administrative and professional services, and related overhead needed to support these efforts.

We expect our expenses to continue to increase in connection with our ongoing activities, particularly as we continue to advance our product candidates into later stages of development, which includes conducting larger clinical trials, and as we commercialize RASONQUE.

We believe that our existing cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities will enable us to fund our planned operations for at least 12 months following the date of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q.
The company expects to report initial clinical monotherapy data in 2027.

The company remains on track to initiate a first-in-human clinical trial evaluating RM-055, a representative of its novel class of mutant-targeted catalytic RAS(ON) inhibitors, in the fourth quarter of 2026.

The company’s development efforts continue to include ongoing clinical collaborations evaluating its RAS(ON) inhibitors in combination with other targeted therapies, including Summit Therapeutics’ PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody and MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitors from Tango Therapeutics and Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS).
Following the live webcast, a replay will be available on the company’s website for at least 14 days.

Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS.
